assert semver.compare("1.0.0-beta", "1.0.0-beta.2") == -1, "beta < beta.2"
assert semver.compare("1.0.0-beta.2", "1.0.0-beta.11") == -1, "beta.2 < beta.11"
assert semver.compare("1.0.0-beta.11", "1.0.0-rc.1") == -1, "beta.11 < rc.1"
assert semver.compare("1.0.0-alpha", "1.0.0") == -1, "pre < release"
assert semver.compare("1.0.0-alpha.1", "1.0.0-0.3.7") == -1, "numeric vs alpha"

# --- Build metadata (does not affect precedence) ---
assert semver.compare("1.0.0+build.1", "1.0.0+build.2") == 0, "build doesn't change order"
assert semver.compare("1.0.0+aaa", "1.0.0+zzz") == 0, "build metadata ignored"

# --- Leading v ---
assert semver.compare("v1.2.3", "1.2.3") == 0, "v prefix ignored"
assert semver.compare("v1.0.0", "v2.0.0") == -1, "v prefix with compare"

# --- Invalid versions ---
for bad in ["", "1.2", "01.2.3", "1.02.3", "1.2.03", "1.2.3-.", "v1.2.3-", "1.0.0-alpha..1"]:
    try:
        semver.compare(bad, "1.0.0")
        print(f"DİKKAT: Geçersiz sürüm yakalanmadı: {bad!r}")

    "1.0.0",
    "1.0.0-alpha",
    "1.0.0-beta",
    "1.0.0-alpha.1",

    "v1.0.0",
    "1.0.0+build",
]

expected = [
    "1.0.0-alpha",
    "1.0.0-alpha.1",
    "1.0.0-beta",
    "1.0.0-beta.2",
    "1.0.0",
    "v1.0.0",
    "1.0.0+build",
]
assert sorted_v == expected, f"{sorted_v} != {expected}"

# --- Stability: equal precedence items keep original order ---
versions2 = ["b", "a"]
semver.compare("b", "a")  # just test compare works
assert semver.sort_versions(versions2) == ["b", "a"], "Stable sort test"

# --- Numeric pre-release comparison ---
assert semver.compare("1.0.0-0", "1.0.0-1") == -1, "0 < 1 numeric pre"
assert semver.compare("1.0.0-1", "1.0.0-10") == -1, "1 < 10 numeric pre"
